name: Pre-holiday effect: buy 1-2 days before exchange holidays
author: StockCharts ChartSchool (Stock Trader's Almanac effect)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: US equity index; holiday calendar specific (not directly applicable to 24/7 crypto).
entry_long: Buy equities one or two trading days before each exchange holiday (President's Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Election Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's).
exit: Short-term: sell just after the holiday (open after holiday). Longer-term: hold until year end.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Source lists 50-year average S&P results by holiday; not reproduced as performance claim. Holiday set is explicit.
